name: @bbox-ui/story-hosts
description: T0 SPIKE: three throwaway host wrappers (DOM / React Flow / tldraw) a Storybook decorator switches between. Proves a story can mount unmodified inside a real React Flow custom node and a real tldraw HTMLContainer shape. WHY this lives outside packages/bbox-ui: the moment @bbox-ui/core imports tldraw or @xyflow/react, the one rule that makes adding a fourth host a 150-line afternoon is gone — see the component-proposal report, Section 5.
